jobs.title: Night Security Officer — Hotel Guest Safety
jobs.description:
Hyatt in Chicago, IL is seeking an Overnight Security Officer to ensure safety for guests and staff across the hotel. You will monitor premises, respond to incidents, and maintain secure operations during the night shift. The role requires reliability and teamwork in a fast-paced hospitality setting.

Ideal candidates will be able to work overnights, weekends, and holidays, with flexibility as needed. Training and benefits are provided as part of Hyatt's commitment to security and guest safety.
